why_ai: Workflow software whose classification and matching layers AI-native entrants can rebuild; lock-in slows switching.
why_clarity: Requisitions, approvals and POs follow rules, though savings figures rest on wrong categories.
why_digital: Transactions and contracts processed in software, sold through enterprise sales and implementation.

why_ai: Comparing structured invoice lines against contract terms at payment is a direct automation.
why_clarity: Each invoice line either matches the contracted price or it does not.
why_digital: Contracts and invoices in, exceptions and recoveries out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Component sourcing depends on supplier relationships and engineering trade-offs; data flow work automates.
why_clarity: Parts are specified by drawings, but sourcing decisions vary by commodity and supplier.
why_digital: Drawings and ERP data on screens, with samples and supplier visits alongside.

why_ai: Classifying and routing employee purchase requests is well-posed work LLM intake handles unassisted.
why_clarity: Each request is routed to the right path, checkable immediately, at high volume.
why_digital: Requests submitted and routed entirely in software.

why_ai: Accountable procurement officers must run statutory processes, but solicitation assembly automates.
why_clarity: Prescribed process and required clauses make compliance checkable; protests surface later.
why_digital: Solicitations built and evaluated digitally; agencies buy through cooperative and public contracts.

why_ai: Multi-year implementations create lock-in, but AI-native tools can replace suite workflows.
why_clarity: Defined workflows recur across organisations, but adoption and savings are hard to verify.
why_digital: Enterprise software sold and deployed through long implementation projects.

why_ai: Assembly and bid normalisation automate; supplier negotiation keeps human judgement and relationships.
why_clarity: Sourcing events follow a standard sequence and savings are measured against baselines.
why_digital: Specifications and bids handled in software, with negotiations by call or meeting.

why_ai: Line-item text classification and entity resolution with abundant labels is core AI capability.
why_clarity: Each line has a correct category and each supplier a real entity, checkable on sample.
why_digital: Transaction data in, classified spend out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Certification checks and spend attribution are mechanical, and DEI backlash shrinks demand.
why_clarity: Certifications are valid or not and spend either reached a certified supplier or not.
why_digital: Certificates and spend records verified and reported online.

why_ai: Dependency mapping is a graph problem over data the company already holds.
why_clarity: Dependency graphs compute cleanly, but disruptions that test them are rare.
why_digital: Supplier and spend data in, risk maps out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Onboarding, catalogue upkeep and invoice submission repeat across buyers and automate directly.
why_clarity: Each portal task is accepted by the buyer system or rejected.
why_digital: Supplier portals, catalogues and invoices are all online.
